content: We need to indicate number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly we need to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we don't have SMILES. The system likely has a sample "at hand". The tools operate on "sample at hand" without needing SMILES. So we can get IR spectra which will show C=O stretch peaks. Or carbon NMR may show carbonyl carbons ~200 ppm. Simpler: use ir_spectra tool to get IR, then count carbonyl peaks (around 1700-1750 cm-1). Let's call ir_spectra.
